req.title: Task creation persists
req.statement: The system shall commit new task rows so subsequent GET calls return them across requests.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates that POST /tasks/ commits new task rows so subsequent GET calls return them. I design: (1) a positive EP test verifying 201 response and exact payload fields, then confirming the task appears in GET /tasks/{id}; (2) a negative NEG test sending a missing required field (title) to confirm 422 client error and no phantom row; (3) a BVA boundary test using a title of exactly 1 character (minimum allowed) and a title of exactly 100 characters (maximum allowed), verifying both persist correctly; (4) a DT test covering the completed=True branch to catch boolean-mutation operators; (5) a STC test verifying the state transition from non-existent to persisted by checking 404 before creation and 200 after. Each test uses an in-memory SQLite override to remain isolated and deterministic.

preconditions: FastAPI app is running in-process with TestClient
actions: POST /tasks/ with valid title, description, completed=False
Assert 201 response with exact payload fields
GET /tasks/{id} with returned id
Assert 200 response and payload matches created task

GET /tasks/{id} returns HTTP 200 with identical title and description

tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db
from app import models

engine_test = create_engine("sqlite:///./test_r021_pos.db", connect_args={"check_same_thread": False})
TestingSessionLocal = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine_test)
models.Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine_test)
models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine_test)

def override_get_db():
    db = TestingSessionLocal()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

def test_create_task_positive_persists_and_retrievable():
    payload = {"title": "Buy groceries", "description": "Milk and eggs", "completed": False}
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    data = r.json()
    assert data["title"] == "Buy groceries"
    assert data["description"] == "Milk and eggs"
    assert data["completed"] == False
    assert isinstance(data["id"], int)
    assert "created_at" in data
    task_id = data["id"]
    r2 = client.get(f"/tasks/{task_id}")
    assert r2.status_code == 200
    data2 = r2.json()
    assert data2["id"] == task_id
    assert data2["title"] == "Buy groceries"
    assert data2["description"] == "Milk and eggs"
    assert data2["completed"] == False

test_create_task_positive_persists_and_retrievable()
app.dependency_overrides.clear()

    assert r1.json()["title"] == "A"
    title_100 = "B" * 100

    assert r3.status_code == 422

    assert r4.status_code == 422

POST /tasks/ to create a task

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db
from app import models

engine_test = create_engine("sqlite:///./test_r021_stc.db", connect_args={"check_same_thread": False})
TestingSessionLocal = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine_test)
models.Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine_test)
models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine_test)

def override_get_db():
    db = TestingSessionLocal()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

def test_create_task_state_transition_nonexistent_to_persisted():
    r_pre = client.get("/tasks/999")
    assert r_pre.status_code == 404
    r_post = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Persist me", "description": "check", "completed": False})
    assert r_post.status_code == 201
    task_id = r_post.json()["id"]
    assert isinstance(task_id, int)
    r_get = client.get(f"/tasks/{task_id}")
    assert r_get.status_code == 200
    assert r_get.json()["title"] == "Persist me"
    assert r_get.json()["description"] == "check"
    assert r_get.json()["id"] == task_id
    r_list = client.get("/tasks/")
    assert r_list.status_code == 200
    ids_in_list = [t["id"] for t in r_list.json()]
    assert task_id in ids_in_list
    assert len(r_list.json()) == 1

test_create_task_state_transition_nonexistent_to_persisted()
app.dependency_overrides.clear()
